sample_unit: daily ED boarding volume forecasts at two EDs

links.outcome: Forecast error of candidate models versus two-week moving-average baseline on the same data
links.effect: VAR+XGBoost lowest RMSE, reducing forecast error by 16-42% at La Jolla and 5-19% at Hillcrest; VAR alone outperformed baseline at both sites; only 0-3% gain of hybrid over VAR.
links.quote: During a four-month validation period, the VAR+XGBoost hybrid achieved the lowest root mean square error-reducing forecast error by 16-42% at La Jolla and 5-19% at Hillcrest-while showing only slight gains over VAR (0-3%).

links.outcome: Prospective forecast performance on live data during a four-month validation period
links.effect: Prospective validation showed VAR+XGBoost and VAR outperformed the baseline at both sites; VAR was then deployed in Mission Control.
links.quote: VAR alone performed robustly and outperformed baseline at both sites.

unlisted_practices: Comparing simple econometric models against machine learning and foundation models for operational forecasting

screen.reason: Prospective evaluation and deployment of machine learning and foundation time-series models for forecasting ED boarding to guide hospital operations.
